subject: Pool orchestration deep dive: sizing, autoscale, and isolation (FinWave)
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
To: Linda Cheng <linda@finwave.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Pool orchestration deep dive — kickoff and times

Hi Linda,

Thanks again for the call last week. FinWave's integration work looks promising and the next logical step is a technical deep-dive focused on Dedicated GPU capacity: pool sizing, autoscale policies, and tenant isolation / failover. We want to ensure the architecture and runbook will meet your SLA mix before the pilot.

Proposed agenda (high-level):
- Current traffic profile & target SLOs (QPS, p99 latency)
- Pool sizing approach (steady vs burst capacity; slot granularity)
- Autoscale policies, cooldowns, and burst fallback tiers
- Isolation and tenant fencing (networking + dataset isolation)
- Runbook: failover, throttling, and mitigation examples
- Open Q&A and next steps

I've attached our capacity-estimates spreadsheet and a quick map of the topics so you have context. Can you share 2–3 preferred 90-minute slots next week? We typically bring Product + Infra (Marissa, Karthik) and the runbook owner for the session.

Attachments: capacity-estimates.xlsx (spreadsheet), FinWave_MAPlayout_v2.pdf (topic map)

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
olga@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0172

Thanks Linda — Wed 24 Feb, 14:00–15:30 PT works for our team. We’ll plan a 90-minute technical session with the following concrete goals:

1) Validate sizing assumptions against FinWave's spike profile and identify minimal reserved capacity to hit p99<500ms for key endpoints.
2) Surface autoscale policy tradeoffs (aggressive scaling vs cost predictability) and propose a default config for the pilot.
3) Define isolation boundaries and a simple fallback routing policy if an instance pool is saturated.
4) Agree owners for runbook actions and post-call deliverables (cap estimates + A/B of autoscale settings).

Please add any agenda items you want covered. I'm attaching a short agenda doc and our template for runbook actions so we can capture owners during the call.

Meeting logistics: will be a Zoom call (I'll send the calendar invite). Can you share whether you'll need a pre-signed NDA/PO for any capacity commitments before pilot? Procurement was cc'd on your earlier reply.

Attachments: pool-orch-agenda.docx, runbook-template.pdf

Best,
Olga
